name: Buddy Christ
look: A photo of a painted statue of Jesus in a cream robe with a red sash and a golden sacred heart on his chest. He grins widely and winks, pointing at the viewer with one hand and giving a thumbs-up with the other, in front of a gray stone wall.
use: A cheesy seal of approval. The caption names a questionable or lazy choice, and the statue's wink, point and thumbs-up cheerfully say it is totally fine.
examples: Totally counts as a balanced meal
describe: jesus statue winking and giving a thumbs up
smiling jesus pointing at you with a thumbs up
cheesy religious statue that winks and points
jesus figure with a big grin and a heart on his robe
statue pointing at the camera with a goofy grin
origin: The Buddy Christ statue from Kevin Smith's 1999 film Dogma, unveiled there as part of a church's 'Catholicism Wow!' campaign.
